lead: A scanner date-parsing bug (flagged below) suppressed today's real story: at least 8 of 33 qualified gainers had genuine, content-verified STRONG filings inside the true 7-day window that the classifier wrongly scored as outside it, pulling several toward lower tiers than the evidence supports. Two are worth Darshan's attention directly: Vikran Engineering (Rs153.76cr POWERGRID order, ~9.8% of market cap, filed yesterday) and Avantel (Rs177.35cr purchase order, ~4.3% of market cap, filed yesterday) both sit in NOTED only because of the bug — both are genuine, quantified, dated triggers. Elsewhere, South Indian Bank's only filing (a 'Change in Management' notice) is actually a mid-level Senior GM appointment, not the leadership change the category tag implies -- its 6% rally on Rs125cr delivery remains effectively unexplained. Hero Motors and SS Retail are both fresh listings (23-Sep) still finding their price on day 2.
caveats: SCANNER BUG: gainersScanner.js's parseCreatedMs() appends a timezone offset directly to date-only strings (e.g. '2026-09-18' -> '2026-09-18+05:30'), which is not valid ISO-8601 and makes Date.parse() return NaN. Every announcement whose only date field is `date` (not `createdAt`) gets days_ago=null and in_scoring_window=false, regardless of true age. Verified: 118/118 announcements in today's run got days_ago=null; 32 of those were content-classified STRONG. Manual correction found 8 companies (UNIDT, VIKRAN, ABDL, RAYMOND, AVANTEL, SOUTHBANK, RAYMONDREL, CRIZAC) with genuine in-window STRONG/VERY_HIGH filings that the classifier scored as if no filing existed. Fix: in parseCreatedMs(), insert 'T00:00:00' before the appended offset for date-only strings. This has likely suppressed ACT-tier signals on every prior run since this code path shipped, not just today.
Stockscans growth-catalyst cache (rung 3a of the WHY ladder) was not warmed for any of today's 20 researched companies -- yarn stockscans:warm needs to run more often.

Given the scope of the date-bug investigation, formal rerating-catalysts EPS-thesis briefs were built/served only for the 2 companies with existing cache (RAYMOND, SEDEMAC); WHY/linkage for the other 8 top-10-by-delivery names (HEROMOTORS, SSRETAIL, ICICIGI, SOUTHBANK, RAYMONDREL, ABDL, GREAVESCOT, KSCL) was resolved directly from filings/concall data rather than a full cached brief -- flagging as deferred per the skill's own allowance.
